class.name: AudioStreamMicrophone
class.description: When used directly in an [AudioStreamPlayer] node, [AudioStreamMicrophone] plays back microphone input in real-time. This can be used in conjunction with [AudioEffectCapture] to process the data or save it. Input is captured as floating-point samples at the rate reported by [method AudioServer.get_input_mix_rate], and resampled to the audio server's mix rate on playback. Use [member playback_delay_ms] to trade latency against robustness to capture jitter. [b]Note:[/b] [member ProjectSettings.audio/driver/enable_input] must be [code]true[/code] for audio input to work. See also that setting's description for caveats related to permissions and operating system privacy settings.

members.member: Delay in milliseconds before playback starts consuming the capture buffer. Higher values add latency but make playback robust to jitter in the capture callback; lower values reduce the delay between speaking and hearing yourself. The delay is clamped internally to the capacity of the driver's input buffer.
